previous_statement: Final assembly: since the pivot s is arbitrary, the pointwise reduction gives S*_s(U) <= Phi_s(U)+2D_+, and the deficit estimate gives D_+ <= (1/2)*Phi_s(U)+3*delta(P); therefore S*_s(U) <= Phi_s(U)+2*((1/2)*Phi_s(U)+3*delta(P)) = 2*Phi_s(U)+6*delta(P) for every pivot s.
new_statement: Final assembly from validated components: fix an arbitrary pivot s and write D_+ as in node 1.1. Node 1.1 gives S*_s(U) <= Phi_s(U)+2D_+. The validated deficit-conclusion node 1.2.6 gives D_+ <= (1/2)*Phi_s(U)+3*delta(P), using the harmonic, decomposition, overshoot, and negative-row bounds already validated in 1.2.1--1.2.5. Therefore S*_s(U) <= Phi_s(U)+2*((1/2)*Phi_s(U)+3*delta(P)) = 2*Phi_s(U)+6*delta(P). Since s was arbitrary, the bound holds for every pivot s.
